rt:param.name: CallLocallyOnly
rt:param.comment: Вызов в/к будет произведён только на этом мониторе (независимо от настроек рабочей группы)

rt:model.rt:event: If Len(ModName) > 0 Then If CallLocallyOnly Then LoadNew(ModName) Else SendNew(ModName) End If End If

Dim wdth As Float Dim hght As Float Dim corner_x As Float Dim t_x As Float Dim W_txt As String Dim H_txt As String Dim C_txt As String Dim halfH_txt As String wdth = _This.width hght = _This.height corner_x = wdth - hght If corner_x < 0 Then corner_x = 0 End If W_txt = RoundAscii(wdth, 2) H_txt = RoundAscii(hght, 2) halfH_txt = RoundAscii((hght / 2), 2) C_txt = RoundAscii(corner_x, 2) bg_grad.points = "0,0 0," + H_txt + " " + C_txt + "," + H_txt + " " + W_txt + "," + halfH_txt + " " + C_txt + ",0" t_x = (wdth - (hght / 2.0)) / 2.0 In_text.x = t_x In_text.y = hght * 0.75 In_text.font_size = hght * 0.75 * T_Resize //определяем угол поворота Dim R_angle As Float R_angle = 0 Dim Occ_Pos As Integer Dim Space_Pos As Integer Occ_Pos = InStr(_This.transform, "rotate(") If Occ_Pos > 0 Then Occ_Pos = Occ_Pos + 7 Space_Pos = InStr(Occ_Pos, _This.transform, " ") If Space_Pos == 0 Then Space_Pos = InStr(Occ_Pos, _This.transform, ")") End If R_angle = CSng(Mid(_This.transform, Occ_Pos, (Space_Pos - Occ_Pos))) If _Err.Number < 0 Then R_angle = 0 End If End If If (InStr(_This.transform, "flipX") > 0) && (R_angle == 0) Then edge_edge_left_top.points = "0,0 " + C_txt + ",0" + " " + W_txt + "," + halfH_txt edge_edge_right_top.points = "0,0 0," + H_txt In_text.transform = "flipX(" + CStr(t_x) + ")" Else If R_angle != 0 Then In_text.setTextLengthChars(0) edge_edge_left_top.points = "0,0 " + C_txt + ",0 " + W_txt + "," + halfH_txt edge_edge_right_top.points = "0,0 0," + H_txt If (R_angle > 45) && (R_angle < 225) Then bg_grad.transform = "flipY(" + halfH_txt + ")" edge_edge_left_top.stroke = "Col_Grey4" edge_edge_bottom_shadow.stroke = "Col_Grey1" Else bg_grad.transform = "" edge_edge_left_top.stroke = "Col_Grey1" edge_edge_bottom_shadow.stroke = "Col_Grey4" End If Else In_text.setTextLengthChars(-1) edge_edge_left_top.points = "0," + H_txt + " 0,0 " + C_txt + ",0" edge_edge_right_top.points = C_txt + ",0 " + W_txt + "," + halfH_txt End If End If edge_edge_bottom_shadow.points = "0," + H_txt + " " + C_txt + "," + H_txt + " " + W_txt + "," + halfH_txt
